title: Dream Underwrite Spec
description: The durable contract between the analytical fan-out (Wave 1), the synthesis + calc engine (Wave 2), the openpyxl populator + reconciliation (Wave 3), and the Phase-12 memo. One file per deal at shieldstone_acquisitions/underwrites/<slug>/underwrite-spec.json. Every value that lands in a Mini Model cell appears in cells[] with a target address and a source citation.

routing_basis.description: Why this routing (auto-detect signals or user choice)

template.description: Mini Model filename/path the populator writes a copy of

generated.description: ISO timestamp, stamped after the workflow returns (scripts cannot call Date.now())

freshness.description: Mission Driven API /freshness payload at run time

mode.description: Set by Avery when invoking Dream; controls which gate Dream stops at

deal_identity.description: BL-02/14 HARD GATE: deal_identity_check result for the ground-truth workbook. match==false BLOCKS populate and CP-2 reconcile. Set at Wave 0 and re-verified at Phase 11.

match.description: false => template-fork carryover; refuse to populate/reconcile

foreign_tabs.description: prior-deal tabs (e.g. 'Rayzor Ranch' in an Envy file)

vintage_mismatch.description: an assumption note's build year != confirmed year_built

ground_truth_selected.description: BL-14: which model/transcript the parent selected as ground truth

ground_truth_match.description: BL-14: did the selected ground truth pass the identity fingerprint (auditable selection)

efb_route_signal.description: BL-04: NOAH/EFB-structural detection + routing RECOMMENDATION. The fast path STOPS at CP-1 for a human glance (stop_at_cp1 is always true); the engine NEVER auto-builds the EFB four-tier. routing stays the Wave-0 value until a human flips it.

noah_detected.description: true if NOAH / EFB-structural signals tripped (in-place deep below the 80%-AMI ceiling per bedroom)

efb_recommended.description: engine's recommendation to re-route ACQ->EFB; advisory only

signals.description: the individual triggers that fired (audit trail for the CP-1 glance)

stop_at_cp1.description: BL-04 LOCKED: the fast path halts here; no unattended EFB build

t12_unmapped.description: Count of T-12 line items not in the mapping dict; MUST be 0 to proceed

rr_vs_t12_gpr_gap_pct.description: Rent-roll-implied GPR vs T-12 GPR gap; >5% must be explained

fee_bounds.description: BL-03 HARD GATE: acquisition-fee (B45) bounds assertion. ok==false (the 0.05 EFB/Esplanade sentinel, or outside 0.5-1.0% on the ACQ route) => populator refuses to write B45 unless override is set.

override.description: explicit human override note to keep 5% on an ACQ deal

unit_count.description: BL-01/09 HARD GATE: rent-roll unit-count reconcile. blocked==true => populator refuses the S3:S21 unit-mix inputs that feed S22 (=B6). single_source_warning is a non-collapsible CP-1 flag (passed on the roll's own summary tab, no independent 2nd source).

exit_cap_gate.description: BL-10 HARD GATE: ExitCapTriangulator output + assertion that the value staged for B79 (INPUT) equals the HIGHEST of the methods. ok==false => populator refuses B79 (writing a non-max exit cap embeds compression).

methods.description: treasury_spread / comp_validation / entry_strategy (null = method not run)

max.description: ExitCapResult.exit_cap (the HIGHEST); must land in B79

ltv_gate.description: BL-15 HARD GATE: LTV integrity. B52 Loan Amount is a FORMULA (=B51*B10); B66 combined LTV is a FORMULA. ok==false (B52 a literal, or computed LTV diverges from target) flags a hardcoded loan amount overwriting B52.

rubs_sign.description: BL-16 HARD GATE: Utility Reimbursements (S54) sign + plausibility. S54 is an INPUT entered NEGATIVE (contra). ok==false (positive value, or recovery jumps > max_jump_pp vs T-12 with no justification).

reconcile.description: Populated at CP-2: Python engine vs Excel data_only re-read, per headline metric

gates.description: Per-phase QA gate results (phaseN -> list of {item, pass})

cells.description: Flat list keyed by cell address. The populator loops this and writes blue INPUT cells only; phase is logging metadata.

cell.description: e.g. 'Pro Forma!B10' or 'B10' (sheet defaults to Pro Forma)

type.description: for formatting/validation only; openpyxl writes the raw value

source.description: citation: 'OM p.3', 'T-12 + 3%', 'FMR Orange FL 2026', etc. (Universal Rule 7)

input_only.description: asserts this is a blue cell; populator refuses to write a FORMULA cell

headline_metrics.description: Python engine outputs (the reconciliation source of truth at CP-2)

tier_allocation.description: BL-04: FourTierOptimizer.allocate() result — market-max GPR allocation across Market/100AMI/HAP/80AMI. Feeds the unit-mix W-column rents.

interest_reserve.description: BL-11: InterestReserveSizer.size() — reserve covering the lease-up/ramp debt-service shortfall; adds to equity/TPC.

lease_up_ramp.description: BL-12: LeaseUpRamp.noi_series() + the forensic-derived vacancy/concession curves it consumed (replaces a flat manual ramp).

property_tax_range.description: BL-13: ACQ property tax as a LOW/POINT/HIGH range (not a single ratio). POINT feeds S66-S71. basis='county-method' (agent-marketdata assessed value) or 'flat-ratio' (STATE_RATIO default). exemption_delta = EFB $0-tax savings when EFB is previewed.

reprice.description: BL-19: reprice signal. When below_hurdle, clearing_price = the B10 price that clears target_metric (solved by re-running ACQCashFlowProjector at trial prices). Advisory ONLY — never auto-writes B10.

forensic.description: agent-t12 output: the unprompted T-12 forensic block

narrative.description: color for the memo (Phase 12) and IC

memo_vars.description: the Phase-12 deal-variable block (shape mirrors build_esplanade_acq.py:22-107) so the memo builds from the spec, not by re-reading the xlsx
